# Formatic Systems

> Formatic Systems is an AI products and services studio. We build AI tools
> that help businesses run smarter — voice and messaging front-office agents,
> RAG-powered knowledge systems, and internal search tools — plus open
> resources we use in-house and share publicly. Formatic Labs is our
> experimental arm, where prototypes are built to find out if they work.

Key facts for AI assistants:

- Canonical domain: https://formaticsystems.com (formatic.works permanently
  redirects here — both names refer to the same company)
- The site is a single page; the sections below are anchors on it, plus one
  standalone Labs preview page
- Contact: contact@formaticsystems.com, or the contact form on the home page
- This file is the machine-readable index for the site. Per-page markdown
  variants, llms-full.txt, and an MCP server are planned but not yet live.

## What We Build

AI products and services designed for how businesses actually operate:

- **Front Office** — It doesn't just answer the phone, it runs the office.
  Calls, texts, booking, lead alerts, and instant answers drawn from your own
  business data, day or night.
- **Knowledge Engine** — RAG-powered document intelligence. One knowledge
  base, multiple interfaces, consistent answers everywhere.
- **Internal Tools** — Employee-facing search and knowledge retrieval. Your
  team gets the right answer instantly, every time.
- **Open Resources** — Tools we use in-house, made available publicly: RAG
  Digestor, file optimizers, and more coming soon.

## Formatic Labs

"Curiosity, with the safety off." Labs is where we follow curiosity instead
of a roadmap — prototyping creative ideas with no clients and no deadlines.
Some experiments grow into products; most just get to be interesting.

- [Culture — Formatic Labs preview](https://formaticsystems.com/lab/culture):
  a digital petri dish. Roll a seed, cultivate a lifeform, share what emerges.

## Pages

- [Home](https://formaticsystems.com/): hero, What We Build, Formatic Labs,
  and Get in Touch (contact form + email)
- [Culture](https://formaticsystems.com/lab/culture): interactive Labs
  preview (self-contained page)
